description: Least-privilege capability for the quick-capture windows (AD-60, FR-101, FR-191, FR-192). Every capability file in this app is window-scoped, so a window with no file of its own can invoke NO plugin permission — it renders and sits inert, which looks like a frontend bug and is not. Story 45.15 made capture windows several and dynamic, so the list carries the prewarmed window's exact label AND the `quick-capture-*` glob every created one matches; `keeper_core::capture::capture_label` derives those labels and its tests pin them to this glob, because a window that matches nothing here fails silently. The grants: `core:default` for channel/event delivery and the app's own invoke path; `core:window:allow-hide` so Escape can dismiss the prewarmed window; `core:window:allow-set-focus` for the Linux compositor race the `keeper://notes-capture-shown` event exists to recover from; `core:window:allow-close` for the close button, which Story 45.15 added because Escape being the only way out is a way out nobody discovers; `core:window:allow-start-dragging` so an UNLOCKED window can be moved — an undecorated window has no title bar to drag, so this is the whole of the lock icon's mechanism; `dialog:allow-open` because capture now mounts the real NoteEditor and Attach a File arrives with it; and `opener:default` so a link in a capture window opens where the same link in the main window opens — a link that silently rejects on one surface and works on the identical control in another is worse than a link that works nowhere. The opener plugin's default scope is `http`, `https`, `mailto` and `tel` and nothing else, so `javascript:` and `file:` are refused by Tauri rather than by a guard of ours. Still NOT granted: deep-link, global-shortcut, process, fs, and any window permission that would let the webview place or resize itself — a window that can place itself is a window that can place itself off screen.
